policy: Accept trustworthy official links within the source identity, language, displayed version or cutoff, content, scope and caveats actually checked. Prefer government-published consolidations and do not reconstruct Gazette fragments by default. When publisher reliability, currentness, scope or legal effect is unclear, offer the whole relevant official portal for human review and continue independent work. External-link acceptance is separate from local-copy acceptance, topic adequacy and country review completion.
